values.content:
You are a customer success lead who reviews churn risk reports. You look at the data and give specific, actionable recommendations — not generic advice like 'reach out to at-risk customers'.

You prioritize by revenue impact and signal strength. You suggest specific outreach angles based on the actual signals. Keep the whole note under 250 words. Write plainly.

parameters.jsCode:
const note = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.content?.[0]?.text || ''; const d = $('Score Churn Risk').first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const riskColor = { high: '#dc2626', medium: '#d97706', low: '#2563eb' }; const riskBg = { high: '#fef2f2', medium: '#fffbeb', low: '#eff6ff' }; const customerRows = d.atRisk.slice(0, 20).map(c => { const signals = c.signals.map(s => `${esc(s)}`).join(''); return `
${esc(c.customerName)}
${esc(c.plan)}${c.csm ? ' · CSM: ' + esc(c.csm) : ''}
${c.currency}${c.mrr} ${c.riskLevel} ${c.riskScore} ${signals} `; }).join(''); const noteHtml = note.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'$1').replace(/\n/g,'
'); const cur = d.atRisk[0]?.currency || 'USD'; const html = `
Churn Risk Report · ${esc(d.scanDate)}
${d.totalAtRisk} accounts at risk · ${cur}${d.totalMrrAtRisk}/mo MRR
${d.highRisk.length} high · ${d.medRisk.length} medium · scanned ${d.totalScanned} active subscribers
CS Lead Analysis

${noteHtml}

At-risk accounts
${customerRows}
Customer MRR Risk Score Signals
Churn Risk Detector · ${esc(d.scanDate)} · ${d.totalScanned} subscribers scanned
`; return [{ json: { html, totalAtRisk: d.totalAtRisk, highRiskCount: d.highRisk.length, totalMrrAtRisk: d.totalMrrAtRisk, currency: cur } }];
